name: bedrock-panel
description: Windows desktop launcher for Minecraft Bedrock server hosting

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bedrock-panel/api" "npm run dev -w @bedrock-panel/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n api,web,desktop -c blue,green,yellow "cross-env WEB_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:5176 npm run dev -w @bedrock-panel/api" "cross-env BEDROCK_PANEL_WEB_PORT=5176 npm run dev -w @bedrock-panel/web" "cross-env BEDROCK_PANEL_UI_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5176 npm run dev -w @bedrock-panel/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bedrock-panel/shared && npm run build -w @bedrock-panel/api && npm run build -w @bedrock-panel/web
scripts.build:production: npm run build && npm run build:copy-web && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bedrock-panel/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bedrock-panel/api && npm run typecheck -w @bedrock-panel/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @bedrock-panel/api && npm run lint -w @bedrock-panel/shared && npm run lint -w @bedrock-panel/web
